claim: React Router v7 loaders/clientLoader fetch route data before render and actions auto-revalidate all loaders after a mutation.
quote: Actions handle data writes ... then automatically revalidates all loaders to keep the UI fresh.

claim: TanStack Router's built-in cache suits apps sharing little data between routes but has no shared caching/deduping and no built-in mutation APIs.
quote: No shared caching/deduping between routes. No built-in mutation APIs. Works great for apps that share little data between routes.

claim: When using TanStack Query, disable the router's cache so one player owns caching; treat loaders as fire-and-forget priming and read via useSuspenseQuery.
quote: when using external caching libraries like TanStack Query, it's best to just turn this off completely because we'd only want one player to control caching.

claim: The TanStack Query integration automates SSR dehydration/hydration and streaming between router and query.
quote: automates SSR dehydration/hydration and streaming between TanStack Router and TanStack Query.

claim: Loaders prefetch via queryClient, useSuspenseQuery reads it, dedup latches onto one request, and useDeferredValue avoids waterfalls.
quote: This allows us access to the queryClient inside of our loader functions via the Router's context.

claim: For CSR-only apps TanStack Query alone works without framework mode; running both loaders and Query in parallel is an anti-pattern.
quote: clean integration requires choosing one primary data-fetching strategy rather than running both in parallel.

claim: React Router cancels interrupted in-flight requests and commits only fresh revalidation responses, but backend integrity is out of scope.
quote: interrupted navigations with links and form submissions will cancel in flight data requests and immediately process the new event.

claim: Fetcher revalidation still has documented race-condition edge cases.
RTK Query and TanStack Query solve the same caching/dedup/refetch problems; RTK Query's tag system auto-refetches related queries after a mutation.
quote: when you update a user, RTK Query automatically refetches all queries tagged with that user. Powerful for admin panels and dashboards.

claim: RTK Query ships an official OpenAPI code generator producing fully-typed endpoints from a spec.
By early 2026 TanStack Query reached roughly 12 million weekly npm downloads.
quote: By early 2026, TanStack Query commands 12 million weekly npm downloads while TanStack Router has accumulated 14,000 GitHub stars.

claim: React Router v7 re-runs loaders by default after mutations, requiring shouldRevalidate/callsite opt-out to prevent unwanted refetches.
quote: loaders will now always re-run by default, and developers should now make use of the shouldRevalidate function
